title: Relative Pronouns with Inanimate Objects and Places: amely, ami, amiben, ahol

sections.title: Connecting descriptions of dwellings and rooms
sections.content: When describing apartments and features, use relative pronouns: *amely / ami* (which / that), inflected with case suffixes such as *amiben* (in which), *amire* (onto which), or place relative adverb *ahol* (where). In formal Hungarian, *amely* is preferred for specific nouns, while *ami* refers to clauses or indefinite antecedents.

items.spanish: Keresünk egy olyan társasházi lakást, amely csendes udvarra néz.
items.english: We are looking for a condominium apartment that overlooks a quiet courtyard.

items.spanish: Ez az a tágas erkély, ahol reggelente szívesen kávézunk.
items.english: This is the spacious balcony where we like to drink coffee in the mornings.

items.spanish: Olyan családi házat szeretnénk, amiben legalább három hálószoba található.
items.english: We would like a detached family home in which at least three bedrooms are found.
